summary: Established and verified a persistent AIDE integrity baseline covering /etc on node1. The baseline contains 39,333 entries, detects changes under /etc, reports clean after restoration, and remained healthy across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed AIDE 0.19.2 from the RHEL repository.
Initialized and activated /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz with root-only permissions and the correct SELinux context.
Verified AIDE initially reported no differences.
Demonstrated detection by adding a temporary /etc file; AIDE reported exactly one added entry.
Removed the probe and verified the baseline returned to a clean state.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the AIDE package, protected database, 39,333 entries, and clean integrity result after restart.

evidence.summary: Shows the active RHEL AIDE rules covering /etc and its security-sensitive subpaths.
Shows successful initialization, activation with mode 0600 and aide_db_t SELinux context, and a clean 39,333-entry check.

evidence.requirement: Later /etc changes can be identified and reported
evidence.summary: AIDE detected exactly one temporary file added under /etc, then reported no differences after it was removed.

Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID 31949c21-52ad-47af-bdbe-893352fd509b, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID dcb30ae0-2181-4bf8-af95-dd7a6db13208, and a recovered clean AIDE check with the protected 39,333-entry database.
